name: sodc-web-demo
description: In-browser interactive demo of the SODC TMT policy.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const dest='../../../PhD/gabrielbena.github.io/assets/sodc-demo';execSync('rm -rf '+dest);execSync('mkdir -p '+dest);require('fs').readdirSync('dist').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f=>execSync('cp dist/'+f+' '+dest+'/'));execSync('cp -r public/weights '+dest+'/weights');console.log('Deployed to '+dest);"
